takes.name: Teacher
takes.description: Direction: a patient, articulate teacher with thoughtful emphasis and a settled ending.

request.voice_description: Preserve this distinctive mature American male voice, its pitch, accent, age and warm natural grain. Give him the delivery of a highly experienced chess teacher: clear deliberate phrasing, patient pauses that separate ideas, precise but unforced consonants, and subtle emphasis on the important reasoning. Quietly intelligent and assured, curious and kind. A conversation with one adult learner, not a lecture hall or announcer. Slightly more measured, never pompous or robotic. The final sentence is a complete conclusion: gently settle the pitch and energy, pronounce the entire last word clearly, let the voice relax naturally, and leave a brief comfortable half-second of silence. Never rush, swallow or abruptly cut off the final syllable. Clean close studio sound without music or effects.

takes.name: Elder
takes.description: Direction: an older, reflective mentor with quiet authority, gentle warmth and an unhurried finish.

request.voice_description: Keep this recognizable warm American male voice and accent. Age him subtly into his early seventies: a little more lived-in texture and rounded resonance, with the composed authority of a wise, thoughtful chess mentor. Precise articulation and reflective pacing, small pauses before an insight, restrained wit and patient warmth. Healthy, alert and engaged; no frail quaver, exaggerated gravel, extra breathiness or caricature. Speak naturally to one adult learner, never boom like an announcer. The final sentence is a complete conclusion: gently settle the pitch and energy, pronounce the entire last word clearly, let the voice relax naturally, and leave a brief comfortable half-second of silence. Never rush, swallow or abruptly cut off the final syllable. Clean close studio sound without music or effects.
